subject: RE: Rainbird — Request to pause demo for procurement evidence collection
messages:
From: Alex Greenwood <alex@rainbird.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@rainbird.ai>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + demo request — Redwood inference

Karthik — great to connect earlier. Our product team is keen to see a short (30–40m) walkthrough focused on real-time inference, latency, and deployment options. Can you do next week? Prefer mornings PT.

If possible please send a short list of artifacts procurement usually asks for so I can kick off our intake in parallel.

Thanks,
Alex Greenwood
Head of Platform Partnerships | Rainbird Systems

Attachment: deck-redwood-quickview.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Procurement Ops <procurement@rainbird.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Greenwood <alex@rainbird.ai>, L. Patel <l.patel@rainbird.ai>
Date: 2027-11-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request — Redwood inference

Karthik — looping in procurement. We need the following items completed before a live demo with our engineering team: 

- Signed NDA (we prefer our template)
- Completed vendor intake questionnaire (attached)
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or evidence of equivalent controls
- High-level network/SSO integration plan (IdP, SAML metadata)

Please pause scheduling the demo until we receive the above. Once items are uploaded to our vendor portal we will triage and propose dates. Typical turnaround is 5–7 business days after receipt of evidence.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf; NDA_Rainbird_template.docx

Thanks,
Procurement Ops
Rainbird Systems
procurement@rainbird.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-08T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + demo request — procurement gating (Rainbird)

Marissa / Ben — FYI: Rainbird procurement just asked to gate the demo until we submit NDA + intake + SOC2 + SSO notes.

Marissa — can you package the SOC2 PDF and a short note on our SOC scope? We can push the SOC2 report (redacted) and the SOC summary to their portal.
Ben — can you produce a 1–page SSO integration summary (IdP options, metadata, expected timeline) and confirm whether we need an SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flow for their setup? Also happy path for short demo (no customer data).

I will sign their NDA and upload the vendor intake. If you want to split the work I can upload the NDA and the intake form and you upload SOC2. We should keep the customer’s ask front and center: they want to pause scheduling until evidence is in.

Thanks — I’ll update when uploaded.

— Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greenwood <alex@rainbird.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@rainbird.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-12T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request — Redwood inference / evidence uploaded

Hi Alex / procurement team — quick update: 

- NDA: signed and returned (attached, ND A_Redwood_signed.pdf).
- Vendor intake: completed and uploaded to your portal (vendor_intake_form.pdf).
- SOC2: latest SOC 2 Type II (redacted PII sections) uploaded (SOC2-type2-2027.pdf).
- SSO summary: attached 1-pager from Ben (SSO-summary-Redwood.pdf).

We also uploaded an evidence confirmation file from Redwood’s compliance bucket (evidence-upload-confirmation.txt). Links to portal entries: https://vendor-portal.rainbird.ai/records/RB-2027-457.

Would you be able to triage and propose a couple of demo slots after review? Our team can do: 
- Thu, 2027-11-18 10:00–10:40 PT (30–40m walkthrough)
- Mon, 2027-11-22 09:00–09:40 PT

If procurement needs more time, we are OK to wait — just want to make sure we have a target to coordinate travel and the engineering calendar.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf; SOC2-type2-2027.pdf; evidence-upload-confirmation.txt
